derived_normals.formula: n = rgb / 127.5 - 1; n.xy *= .25; n = normalize(n); rgb = round((n + 1) * 127.5)
derived_normals.color_space: Raw normal data; no sRGB transform
derived_normals.compatibility: Bevy 0.19.1 glTF loader does not apply normalTexture.scale; bake xy attenuation into RGB data and use Blender Strength/glTF scale 1
